step1_analysis.circuit_type: Differential Amplifier with Source Follower Buffers
step1_analysis.description: A differential pair (XM1, XM2) providing voltage gain, followed by source follower buffers (XM3, XM4) for driving subsequent stages or loads. This topology is commonly used in high-speed optical receivers for wideband amplification.

paper_reference.title: A Burst-Mode Receiver for 1.25-Gb/s Ethernet PON With AGC and Internally Created Reset Signal

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = sqrt(2 * 270uA/V^2 * (5/0.5) * 0.25mA) = 1.16 mS. Gain = gm * Rload = 1.16mS * 2kOhm = 2.32 V/V = 7.3 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 21 dB for the entire receiver chain. This single differential stage with 2kOhm loads provides around 7.3 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rload * Cload). Assuming parasitic Cload ~ 50fF, BW = 1 / (2 * pi * 2k * 50f) = 1.6 GHz
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be in the GHz range, consistent with the 1.25-Gb/s EPON standard mentioned in the paper.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the stage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the bias currents added to the testbench to ensure proper operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With a 0.4Vpp differential input (0.2V amplitude) and a gain of ~2.3 V/V, the output swing is 0.4 * 2.3 = 0.92 Vpp
sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from the expected gain and the applied 0.4Vpp differential input in the transient simulation.

input_capacitance.description: Input capacitance of the differential pair

sky130_expected.calculation: Cgg = W * L * Cox = 5um * 0.5um * 5.7fF/um^2 = ~14 fF. Plus overlap and parasitic capacitance, expect ~20 fF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 250 fF likely refers to the photodiode or pad capacitance. The intrinsic gate capacitance of a 5u/0.5u NMOS is much smaller.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure differential gain, bandwidth, power consumption, and transient output swing of the amplifier stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Burst-Mode Receiver Differential Stage
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

* DUT
XM4 VDD N2 OUT1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM3 VDD N1 OUT2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM1 N1 IN1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 IN2 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Biasing components (added to complete the circuit)
R1 VDD N1 2k
R2 VDD N2 2k
I_tail N4 0 0.5m
I_out1 OUT1 0 0.5m
I_out2 OUT2 0 0.5m

* Power supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Inputs (DC common-mode = 1.2V, AC diff = 1V, Tran diff = 0.4Vpp)
VIN1 IN1 0 DC 1.2 AC 0.5 SIN(1.2 0.1 100MEG 0 0)
VIN2 IN2 0 DC 1.2 AC -0.5 SIN(1.2 -0.1 100MEG 0 0)

* Differential output voltage controlled voltage source
E_diff OUT_DIFF 0 OUT1 OUT2 1.0

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
print v(OUT1) v(OUT2) v(N1) v(N2) v(N4)
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis (Gain and Bandwidth)
ac dec 20 1Meg 10G
meas ac max_gain max vdb(OUT_DIFF)
meas ac bw when vdb(OUT_DIFF)='max_gain - 3' fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis (Output Swing)
tran 0.1n 20n
meas tran vout_diff_max max v(OUT_DIFF)
meas tran vout_diff_min min v(OUT_DIFF)
let vout_swing = vout_diff_max - vout_diff_min
print vout_swing

quit
.endc
.end
